# FDG9011

> DO NOT require users of aggregate components to inherit, override methods, or implement any interfaces in common scenarios.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.1.3 Aggregate Component Guidelines.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

Not machine-checkable: which scenarios are common, and whether they require inheriting, overriding or implementing an interface, needs the scenarios. The Cwalina annotation in section 9.1 (System.ServiceProcess) is an example.

## From the book

Components should mostly rely on properties and composition as the means of modifying their behavior.
